readme_entries.description: All explicitly EUR-normalized workbook values use EUR.
Business dates and schedules use Europe/Paris.

readme_entries.value: _current sheets are nontransactional physical tables; validate membership before use
readme_entries.description: For the selected successful run, inspect full accounts_current and positions_current tables before filtering: require non-empty unique canonical keys and BOOLEAN flags (native booleans or exact TRUE/FALSE). Every active last_seen_run_id must equal the selected run_id; active counts must equal accounts_count and positions_count. Counts accept finite non-negative integer numbers or decimal numeric strings, never blanks or booleans. Reject extra, missing, duplicate or foreign active rows without deduplication. Active positions must reference validated active accounts; when joining validated history, position-key sets must agree. Inactive rows do not count and retain their last observation run, not their last write. If either table fails, do not use it as a complete asset snapshot; use validated history or report unavailable.

readme_entries.value: positions_history rows require independently validated daily and successful-run membership
readme_entries.description: For a date, require one portfolio_daily row and exactly one terminal sync_runs record for portfolio_daily.run_id, with successful status and timezone-aware completed_at; coverage and shared totals must agree. Check canonical history_key and unique non-empty position_key across the date before selecting matching run_id rows; their count must equal valid positions_count and generated_at must match the daily row. Distinct retained keys from older runs are excluded. A success cannot restore overwritten rows. If current data fails, use independently valid history, newest valid date first, disclosing date, run_id, completion time and freshness (stale after 48 hours); otherwise report detail unavailable. Never enrich history from invalid current rows, invent unretained fields, or reconstruct account balances. A separately validated daily aggregate can remain usable without position detail; label its own run and date.

readme_entries.value: asset_overrides is authoritative over automatic classification
readme_entries.description: Enabled exact-match overrides determine final classification.

readme_entries.value: blank means unknown or unavailable; blank never means zero
readme_entries.description: Numeric nulls are empty cells, not text or zero placeholders.

readme_entries.value: position EUR fields exist only with verified EUR provenance
readme_entries.description: No display-field inference or speculative conversion is allowed.

readme_entries.value: account balances are authoritative; never add position values to account balances
readme_entries.description: Use gross_assets_eur from a validated portfolio_daily state, never reconstruct account balances or gross assets from position sums. Preserve blank EUR values and partial known-EUR allocation coverage.

readme_entries.value: invalid bridge responses fail before writes; interrupted Sheets writes can replace physical state
readme_entries.description: Explicit PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE liability coverage remains a valid asset snapshot. Absence of FAILED telemetry does not prove success. Validate observed membership and completeness; sequential reads are not a transactional snapshot, even if repeated reads agree. Reject observed changes or inconsistencies and retry a full read after writes settle.

readme_entries.value: liability_coverage is authoritative only with validated evidence; blanks never mean zero
readme_entries.description: Only a validated COMPLETE daily state permits numeric liability and net-worth totals for that date. Detailed rows require separate complete-run validation. Under PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE, current liabilities and net worth remain unknown; never subtract older last-known liabilities from newer gross assets as authoritative current net worth.

readme_entries.value: PARTIAL records are not a complete debt set and are not written to liabilities_current
readme_entries.description: Only COMPLETE coverage may modify liabilities_current.

readme_entries.value: UNAVAILABLE means no authoritative liability collection
readme_entries.description: Gross assets remain analyzable while liability and net-worth totals remain blank.

readme_entries.value: validate liabilities_current independently against the latest successful COMPLETE run
readme_entries.description: Require exactly one successful terminal record, timezone-aware completed_at, a finite non-negative integer liabilities_count, non-empty unique canonical liability keys and valid BOOLEAN flags across the full table. Every active last_seen_run_id must equal that COMPLETE run_id and the active count must match; exclude retained inactive rows with older observation IDs. Verify finite outstanding amounts against the complete total and consistent last_seen_at observations (arithmetic tolerance 1e-8 EUR, as in prewrite validation; counts and zero evidence remain exact). Reject partial failed COMPLETE writes; there is no liability history fallback. A newer PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE asset run, including a same-day daily replacement, does not invalidate independently proven liability rows. Empty active data proves zero only with matching successful COMPLETE evidence, zero count and zero liabilities_eur. Disclose the separate run, completion time and retained snapshot date; if zero rows and no matching daily row remain, snapshot date is unavailable.

readme_entries.value: allocation percentages exclude liabilities and use only known-EUR active positions
readme_entries.description: Allocation may describe partial known-EUR coverage.

readme_entries.value: the latest successful execution is the newest completed_at with status SUCCESS or SUCCESS_WITH_WARNINGS
readme_entries.description: Compare parsed timezone-aware instants; run_id is an opaque equality key, never sortable. Require exactly one terminal record per candidate run, including failure records when checking duplicates. Missing or conflicting evidence, duplicate terminal records, and tied newest instants cannot establish a unique latest success. A later FAILED row does not replace a successful execution. The latest success is distinct from the latest state whose required data remains available and valid; validate each source and disclose any dated fallback.

readme_entries.value: valuation changes are not investment performance unless external cashflows are complete
readme_entries.description: Contributions and withdrawals must be separable before a valuation change may be described as investment performance.
Select a validated successful observation; detail sums do not replace totals.

mcp_identity.encoding: E(x) = percent-encode each UTF-8 byte except ASCII ALPHA/DIGIT/-._~, uppercase hex; never trim, case-fold, Unicode-normalize, decode or numerically coerce IDs. Reject empty/whitespace/control source IDs and inputs >256 characters. Encoded keys may exceed source-ID length.
mcp_identity.observation_id: fresh UUID per bridge collection, retained for retries of that exact payload only
mcp_identity.run_id: existing restored-safe n8n identity, one terminal outcome; observation_id separately binds immutable data
mcp_identity.observation_child_key: {observation_id}:{E(table)}:{E(component1)}:...; fixed arity per table; optional components use nullable_key_components tags; ordinal components are canonical base-10 nonnegative integers and local to observation only
mcp_identity.legacy: Keep all finary:* keys and date-only daily/history keys unchanged. Never infer a cross-provider match from equal IDs, name, ticker, ISIN or order.
mcp_identity.nullable_key_components: Encode absent optional child-key component as literal ~null and present components as ~value followed by E(value); this discriminates an absent warning entity from any real ID. Fixed table key arity; no delimiter ambiguity.

mcp_numeric_policy.revision_reason: Contract 1.1.0 raises the project fractional bound from 18 to 64 after an operator-run native accounts read reported a plain decimal with more than 18 significant fractional digits. Preserve the exact source string; never round. The 64-place cap is a bounded project policy, not a verified upstream maximum.
mcp_numeric_policy.ingestion: Decimal constructed directly from bounded strings; no float intermediate; validate lexical length before parsing; preserve exact value; reject malformed/non-finite/out-of-range without truncation or rounding
mcp_numeric_policy.absence: absent/null unknown, zero is known; reject booleans, blanks and text placeholders as amounts
mcp_numeric_policy.sheets: new monetary/quantity/rate columns use exact decimal TEXT written RAW; nullable cells explicitly cleared; legacy numeric columns remain as-is and do not receive MCP amounts
mcp_numeric_policy.simulation: Declared numeric tool inputs/outputs are separate approximate on-demand results; enforce finite JSON numbers and implementation-time bounds before invocation. Never use as ingestion decimals.
mcp_numeric_policy.equality: Compare validated decimal strings by exact numeric value, never lexical spelling or binary floats. No canonical scale: 0, 0.00 and -0.00 are equal; 250.0 and 250.00 are equal. Preserve source spelling in stored decimal text; equality does not round or relax lexical bounds.

README.purpose: Human-readable and ChatGPT-readable workbook data dictionary.
README.update_behavior: Initialized from the schema definition; portfolio synchronization must not rewrite it.

accounts_current.purpose: Physical normalized account rows, including inactive retention; usable only after successful-run membership and completeness validation.
accounts_current.update_behavior: Upsert valid v2 asset snapshots by account_key; mark missing rows inactive after prewrite validation. Writes are nontransactional; consumers must validate successful-run membership and active counts.

columns.name: last_seen_run_id
columns.source: last snapshot observation run; retained unchanged when inactivated, not the last write ID

positions_current.purpose: Physical normalized position rows per account, including inactive retention; usable only after successful-run membership and completeness validation.
positions_current.update_behavior: Upsert valid v2 asset snapshots by position_key; mark missing rows inactive after prewrite validation. Writes are nontransactional; consumers must validate successful-run membership and active counts.

columns.name: last_seen_run_id
columns.source: last snapshot observation run; retained unchanged when inactivated, not the last write ID

liabilities_current.purpose: Physical liability rows requiring independent validation against the latest successful COMPLETE run; may be empty, older than assets, or partially overwritten.
liabilities_current.update_behavior: Upsert or inactivate only when liability_coverage is COMPLETE; PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE never writes, clears, or deactivates rows.
liabilities_current.deletion_behavior: Never delete automatically; missing rows may be marked inactive only from a complete liability collection.

columns.name: last_seen_run_id
columns.source: last snapshot observation run; retained unchanged when inactivated, not the last write ID

positions_history.purpose: Date-scoped retained history with explicit successful-run membership.
positions_history.update_behavior: Upsert the same date and position_key with the current run_id; create a new row on a later date.

columns.name: run_id
columns.source: sync run context; blank only on legacy rows written before schema 2.1

portfolio_daily.purpose: One physical daily portfolio summary with nullable analytical coverage; consumers validate its terminal evidence before using aggregates and history membership before using position detail.
portfolio_daily.update_behavior: Upsert the same Europe/Paris business date from any valid v2 asset snapshot.

columns.name: liabilities_eur
columns.source: PortfolioSnapshot.liabilities_eur when a complete snapshot exists

columns.name: net_worth_eur
columns.source: PortfolioSnapshot.net_worth_eur when a complete snapshot exists

columns.name: financial_assets_eur
columns.source: known-EUR active position subset when coverage is sufficient

columns.name: pea_eur
columns.source: known-EUR accounts whose stable account_type is PEA

columns.name: cto_eur
columns.source: known-EUR accounts whose stable account_type is CTO

columns.name: life_insurance_eur
columns.source: known-EUR accounts whose stable account_type is life insurance

columns.name: cash_accounts_eur
columns.source: known-EUR accounts whose stable account_type is cash

allocation_targets.purpose: User-maintained target allocation ranges using decimal fractions.
allocation_targets.update_behavior: User-managed only; portfolio synchronization must never overwrite rows.

asset_overrides.purpose: User-maintained deterministic corrections to normalized position classification.
asset_overrides.update_behavior: User-managed only; portfolio synchronization reads but never overwrites rows.

cashflows.purpose: User-maintained external flows and transfers; the application does not calculate investment performance.
cashflows.update_behavior: User-managed only; portfolio synchronization must never overwrite rows.

sync_runs.purpose: Append-oriented synchronization telemetry, not portfolio state.
sync_runs.update_behavior: Append one terminal record per originating n8n execution; native node retries retain that execution identity.

columns.name: run_id
columns.source: opaque UUID-bearing identity saved at originating n8n initialization; legacy values remain valid

columns.name: completed_at
columns.source: terminal payload finalization instant; for success, after required portfolio writes and before the terminal Sheets request, excluding its response and retries

columns.name: liability_coverage
columns.source: PortfolioSnapshotV2.coverage.liabilities when a valid snapshot was decoded

columns.name: net_worth_change_pct
columns.source: current and previous known net worth

columns.name: duration_ms
columns.source: for success, finite elapsed epoch milliseconds from the originating execution start to completed_at, clamped to zero for backward clock adjustments; failure telemetry retains its existing conventions
